A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the riparian zone is an important source of DOC to the streams, but that its relative importance is strongly dependent on hydrological connectivity.

the model design and calibration should reflect the relative importance of the different sources of DOC to the streams, and that these should be conceptualised in terms of hydrological connectivity.
